question: What is the main goal of public health agencies compared to individual hospital care?

options.B: Population-wide disease prevention and health promotion

explanation: Health maintenance agencies focus on community health, disease tracking, and prevention rather than treating single patients at the bedside. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h1)

question: Why do clinical nurses need to understand the role of health maintenance agencies?

options.A: To manage the financial budget of government hospitals
options.B: To participate effectively in public health campaigns and disease reporting
options.C: To handle international travel arrangements for patients
options.D: To prescribe medications outside their normal scope of practice

explanation: Nurses collaborate with these agencies during outbreaks, immunizations, and mandatory reporting procedures. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h1)

question: Which Nigerian agency is responsible for regulating food and pharmaceutical drugs?
explanation: NAFDAC is specifically mandated to regulate and control the manufacture, importation, and use of drugs, food, and medical devices in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h2)

question: A nurse finds a batch of expired vaccines at a primary health clinic. Which national body handles immunization programs to address this?
explanation: The National Primary Health Care Development Agency oversees immunization programs and primary health facility operations in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h2)

question: What is the main global health role of the World Health Organization (WHO)?

options.A: Coordinating international health standards and disease surveillance
options.C: Enforcing local food safety laws in Nigeria
options.D: Building private hospitals in developing countries

explanation: The WHO acts as the lead international authority for establishing health guidelines and monitoring global disease outbreaks. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h3)

question: A community health nurse takes part in a UNICEF-backed nutrition drive for mothers and children. What does this show?

options.A: The privatization of primary healthcare services in Nigeria
options.B: A shift from clinical nursing to international diplomacy
options.C: International agencies partnering with local systems to improve target population health
options.D: The total replacement of national government health duties by foreign bodies

explanation: Global bodies like UNICEF work alongside national health frameworks to execute targeted interventions like child and maternal health programs. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h3)

question: What is a major day-to-day role for nurses working in community health programs?

options.B: Drafting international health treaties and global budgets
options.C: Enforcing customs laws at national borders
options.D: Executing policies, collecting data, and educating communities

explanation: Nurses translate macro-level health policies into direct patient care, health education, and data collection on the ground. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h4)

question: Why is accurate record-keeping by nurses important for health maintenance agencies?

options.A: It allows nurses to receive international travel grants
options.B: It proves that hospitals are making a financial profit
options.C: It helps agencies evaluate program success and allocate resources properly
options.D: It replaces the need for government health ministries

explanation: Agencies rely on field data collected by nurses to track disease trends and determine where future medical supplies and funding should go. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h4)

question: Which level of healthcare provides the first point of contact for basic ailments before a referral?
explanation: Primary health centers form the first point of contact in the referral chain, handling basic community care before sending complex cases upward. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h5)

question: A nurse is preparing a patient for transfer from a rural clinic to a teaching hospital. What is the most important action for smooth continued care?

options.A: Notifying the federal ministry of health immediately
options.C: Sending a complete clinical summary and accurate patient history
options.D: Waiting for international health agencies to approve the transfer

explanation: A proper handover requires thorough documentation so the receiving facility understands the patient's condition and treatment history. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h5)

question: Which of these is NOT a common challenge for health agencies in developing regions?

options.B: Inadequate funding and financial resource allocation
options.C: Excessive surplus of modern medical infrastructure
options.D: Brain drain of skilled healthcare professionals

explanation: Infrastructure deficits are a major challenge, meaning agencies suffer from a lack of facilities rather than an excessive surplus. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h6)

question: How do digital health tools help modern health maintenance agencies?

options.A: By eliminating the need for nurses and community health workers
options.B: By enabling faster disease outbreak detection and better data integration
options.C: By stopping the need for government healthcare budgets
options.D: By replacing all physical hospitals with online websites

explanation: Electronic health systems and digital tools allow agencies to collect real-time health data and respond swiftly to public health threats. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h6)
